detail: Help shows 'The selected content is currently unavailable' after installing a new build
error: Help shows 'The selected content is currently unavailable' after installing a new build
fix: The book carries the app's version, which make app now bumps every release, so each release is a new cache entry; cleared helpd's cache folder once more, killall helpd, lsregister -f the app

Anchor picture showed only half its ring in Safari while coming into view; Chrome drew it whole
error: Anchor picture showed only half its ring in Safari while coming into view; Chrome drew it whole
fix: No clip: draw every part solid, shade with source-in over the whole, then erase the part not yet in view with destination-out
root_cause: WebKit applies a canvas clip differently with source-in compositing: the reveal clip and the source-in shading pass disagreed, leaving parts unshaded and the rest undrawn

root_cause: Placed in physical pixels, which aren't one space across screens of different scales; the icon can be reported a few points above a higher screen's top so no screen matched; a click on the other screen's icon was taken as the click that closes the menu
